Just as in the standing discipline, you are an architect of momentum, using your core strength and explosive power to turn gravity into competitive performance in the same high-stakes environment of The LA28 Games.

Your lean efficiency and aptitude for team dynamics define the Road Machine, where tactical awareness and shared intensity drive results. In the standing pathway, you channel your power into the collective rhythm of a pack, focusing on drafting and pacing to optimize performance across long-distance efforts. This requires a shift from singular bursts to sustained output, making you a vital strategic asset within the endurance landscape of The LA28 Games.

In the adaptive pathway, you apply this tactical depth to handcycling, where your high-intensity energy is integrated into the complex demands of road racing. Your focus here is on maximizing propulsion through disciplined, repetitive motor control while navigating the tactical pressures of a multi-athlete field. By balancing your inherent explosive speed with the sustained endurance required for this path, you become an essential contributor to the team-oriented competitive environment of The LA28 Games.
